newsitem.title: CHINA: EASYKNIT TO PLACE 377.8 MLN NEW SHARES.
newsitem.headline: EASYKNIT TO PLACE 377.8 MLN NEW SHARES.

text.p: Easyknit International Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it would place 377.8 million new shares at HK$0.56 per share to independent investors, raising net proceeds of HK$208.9 million.

It said it would use about HK$100 million of the net proceeds to reduce bank borrowings, a further HK$80 million to complete the purchase of three retail shops in Excelsior Plaza, Hong Kong, and the balance for general working capital.
The new shares represent about 15.17 percent of the company's existing share capital.
